summary: Rhinebeck Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an Agency Agreement with Keefe, Bruyette & Woods (KBW) for marketing its stock offering of up to 8,912,500 shares at $10.00 per share. KBW receives a $50,000 management fee (paid), success fees of 1.0% to 1.5% of subscription and community offering proceeds, and up to 6.0% for a syndicated community offering. Also a records agent fee of $45,000. The shares are offered via a Form S-1 registration statement. This is a capital-raising event through a mutual-to-stock conversion offering, not a routine contract. Watch for subscription period close and conversion completion; typical risk-arb angle is the offering price stability.
